comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On dak.gg/er the PAM ad popup (whose blocked creative leaves the reporter's empty "광고 이미지" placeholder), the unfilled in-page ad slot #⁠er_top and the app-install bottom sheet were all reproduced in the AdGuard CLI baseline, and one domain-scoped cosmetic rule hiding exactly those three containers was verified (popup/slot/sheet visible in phase B, hidden in phase C, page integrity intact). Proposed for BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt. ## Rule `dak.gg##div:has(> div > #er_top),body > div[data-pam-popup],body > div:has(> div a.install-link[href*="gg.dak.bser"])` ## Policy rationale No rule of the run instruction's policy closes this report:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German (or any) anti-adblock wall - no detector request appears in the captured network log and the page shows no wall - and not a scam, phishing or tech-support page. The 'site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing' rule does not cover the reported ad containers:⁠ the popup carries a third-party advertiser creative (Monster Hunter Now) served through pam.dakgg.io / pam-assets.dak.gg and #⁠er_top is a Google ad slot left unfilled after the gpt tag is redirected, which is not self-promotion as the filter policy's Terminology defines it (goods or services owned by the site owner with no third-party compensation). The app-install bottom sheet is a self-promotion annoyance in the AdGuard Mobile App Banners category, which the repository already maintains rules for on this very site, so removing it is rule generation in the annoyance family rather than deliberate blocking of the site's own ads in the ad filters. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1b236f4815f33f6723f7b35a62e430ea41c310fc/BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 1303](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1b236f4815f33f6723f7b35a62e430ea41c310fc/BaseFilter/sections/specific.txt#L1303). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported click-triggered pop-under on goflix.sbs never opened in any phase of this run (5 rehearsed clicks and identical revealSteps with 0 popups unfiltered, on the baseline, and with a candidate), and the page's inline pop-under packer is already targeted by AdGuard Base filter's shared goflix.* scriptlet. The environment produced no prepared-extension symptom classification and the candidate scriptlet's review was inconclusive, so the best candidate is carried for human review rather than proposed.

## Candidate for review

`goflix.sbs#%#//scriptlet('prevent-window-open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: apply_rule did not reject the candidate but could not verify it:⁠ its visual review came back inconclusive (verdict 'inconclusive', symptom 'unclear', failedCandidateChecks empty) because final vision synthesis failed after 3 attempts, and the click rehearsal opened 0 popups in phase A (unfiltered), phase B (baseline) and phase C (baseline + candidate), so no phase difference could be attributed to the rule. The run's environment also produced no prepared-extension symptom classification (preparedSessionId null), and this candidate is a JavaScript scriptlet that AdGuard for iOS's Safari content-blocking execution model — the reporter's product — cannot execute, so even a verified rule here would not address the reporter's platform.

Despite multiple troubleshooting steps and clean reinstalls, the app window never appears on the screen. > > Here is the full background and a detailed list of everything that has been done so far: > > ### Hardware Context & Trigger: > 1. The issue started right after I performed major hardware changes: I replaced my GeForce GTX 970 with an RTX 4090 and reset my BIOS. > 2. Due to separate system/memory issues with the new card, I physically removed the RTX 4090 and reinstalled my original GTX 970. > 3. Since reverting back to the GTX 970, the AdGuard UI has completely disappeared and fails to load. > > ### Troubleshooting Steps Already Taken: > * Service Verification: I checked Windows Services (services.msc). The AdGuard Service is registered, status is Running, and it is set to Automatic. The background filtering engine seems to be working, but the GUI doesn't trigger. > * Direct Execution Commands: I attempted to force-launch the interface via the Windows Run dialog using "C:\Program Files\AdGuard\AdGuard.exe" /show as well as /show /reset. The command executes without any Windows error popup, but absolutely nothing happens on screen. > * Compatibility & Admin Mode: I applied "Run as Administrator" and tested running the executable in Windows 8 Compatibility Mode, with no success. > * Official Cleanup & Reinstallation: I downloaded and used the official AdGuard Uninstall Utility to perform a Standard Uninstall without deleting my user settings. After restarting the PC, I downloaded the latest installer from the official website and reinstalled it. The installer finished successfully, but the UI still won't open. > * GPU Hardware Acceleration Test: Suspecting a display conflict, I tried executing the command with the GPU bypass flag: "C:\Program Files\AdGuard\AdGuard.exe" /disable-gpu, but the interface still failed to render. > * Graphics Drivers Cleanup: I performed a completely clean installation of the official NVIDIA graphics drivers for the GTX 970 using the "Perform a clean installation" option to wipe any leftover registry paths or driver traces from the RTX 4090. The drivers were successfully updated, yet the issue persists. > * Antivirus Exclusion: I temporarily disabled my Avast Antivirus shields to ensure it wasn't silently blocking the UI thread from launching, which made no difference. > > ### Current State: > Fortunately, I have a safe manual backup of my %ProgramData%\Adguard folder (including the Backups directory with my .zip configuration files) saved on my desktop, so my data is secured. > > However, since the WPF/XAML graphical interface entirely fails to load, I cannot access my settings, check my license, or interact with the app. > > Given that the background service is running but the GUI is completely unresponsive (likely due to a deep rendering hook conflict caused by the GPU swapping/BIOS reset), could you please advise on how to force the UI to initialize or debug this specific crash? > > Thank you in advance for your assistance! ### Screenshots

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"44d93dbcb4f3aae61755dca9a089097919e799d783f2d8dc6f31f19c24fbb48f"} -->
The filter policy leaves this report to a maintainer

## Reproduced symptom

The Vietnamese anti-adblock wall (div.MuiDialog-root.block-ad-modal, "Vui lòng tắt tiện ích chặn quảng cáo để xem phim") appears only while filtering is active and is gone in an unfiltered control, but no detector script can be named from the captured requests, so per the anti-adblock policy the report goes to a maintainer. The narrow fix danet.vn#⁠#⁠.block-ad-modal hides the wall and its backdrop in the bound experiment, yet the vision review kept reading the site's own dark theme as a leftover overlay and hiding alone leaves MUI's body scroll lock, so it stays unverified.

## Still visible after the rule

- VUA ĐẦU BẾP MỸ - MÙA 8 / Danh sách tập | 21 tập / Thông báo — The whole movie-page area (title, description, episode thumbnails, related-film section) is covered by a dark dimming overlay and the content is withheld behind the anti-adblock "Thông báo" gate, so the episode list cannot be browsed; the dialog box itself is not legible in this tile, but the dimmed backdrop and the gated page content are visible.
- Full-page dim overlay covering the movie title/description, the "Danh sách tập | 21 tập" episode list, and the "Phim đề xuất" section; the centered dialog area itself is in the middle of this dimmed region — The entire movie page is visibly darkened by the anti-adblock modal's dimming backdrop:⁠ text, poster and episode thumbnails are all muted under a dark layer. The centered "Thông báo" dialog with the green "Tải lại trang" button is not rendered visibly in this capture, but its dimming overlay persists over the content the reporter could not reach, so the reporter-defined symptom footprint (overlay/modal region blocking the page) is still present.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ 'Any other anti-adblock wall:⁠ write a rule only once the page's requests the agent captured show the detector script; without it, hand the report to a maintainer.' The wall here is Vietnamese (not German), so the German-wall close rule does not apply; the detector is not a nameable request. Captured requests (artifact:⁠har:⁠9c3d645a-79b5-48f7-b2b1-6aaab37454d2 reporter profile, artifact:⁠har:⁠6cfdc49e-1973-49b4-ae50-d72ac55767a6 unfiltered control) contain no distinct detector script:⁠ everything is first-party danet.vn Next.js chunks plus the site's own ad loader /ads/adframe.js and /api/ads?type=OPENING_POPUP_BANNER_PROGRAMMATIC, so the blocker check cannot be attributed to a specific script from the inventory. The only cosmetic candidate (danet.vn#⁠#⁠.block-ad-modal) was not verified:⁠ the bound vision review returned 'not_resolved' in both of its completed runs, reading the page's own dark theme as a persistent dimming overlay, which the phase-B/phase-C DOM checks contradict; and hiding alone leaves MUI's inline body scroll lock (body style='overflow:⁠ hidden;') in place, so a companion rule is needed - a single-rule outcome cannot cover it.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40815054569

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reporter's cookie notice on www⁠.rescana.com is the site's own fixed bottom cookie bar (#⁠rescana-consent-banner), and no existing list rule touches it. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule, rescana.com#⁠#⁠#⁠rescana-consent-banner, was verified in the prepared AdGuard Browser Extension:⁠ the bar is visible before and gone after, with page integrity intact and no layout residue. ## Rule `rescana.com###rescana-consent-banner` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie notice, which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists to block; it is not first-party advertising, not a paywall and not a German anti-adblock wall, so no run-instruction rule closes it. No rule in the repository covers www⁠.rescana.com (search_rules returns 0 matches for the domain, the selector and the script URL), so a new domain-scoped rule is needed. The fix is a cosmetic hide of the site's own consent bar, which the filter policy explicitly allows ('simply hiding ... the corresponding scripts is sufficient'). ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/d700b2d77a9c51532a209322139487bc88ee0644/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

The page's own first-party Framer consent banner is baked into the served page (no detector script or anti-adblock measure involved), which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter is meant to cover. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/d700b2d77a9c51532a209322139487bc88ee0644/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 5639](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/d700b2d77a9c51532a209322139487bc88ee0644/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L5639). ## Screenshots

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"af4764b87c9f2e0fc76360d281715296bdc817d9c9fde8aa8245e2fbb7814cfc"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

Reproduced the reporter's overlay live on the wiwo.de article:⁠ a German modal stating that an active ad blocker is presumably blocking the consent banner and asking the user to deactivate the blocker for the site and reload. That is a German site's anti-adblock wall, which the run instruction's filter policy excludes from rule generation ("no rule; recommend closing"), so the report is recommended for closing rather than patched.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ "German anti-adblock walls:⁠ no rule; recommend closing. This covers only a German site's wall or popup that detects the ad blocker and asks to disable it or to allowlist the site. A page in German is not enough, and the reporter's choice of 'anti-adblock' as the problem type is not evidence:⁠ check what the page itself shows." The page itself shows the qualifying wall:⁠ the live and reported overlay reads "Das liegt vermutlich an einem aktiven Content- oder Adblocker, der unser Consent-Banner blockiert. Bitte deaktivieren Sie den Blocker für diese Website und laden Sie die Seite neu, um fortzufahren." with a "Seite neu laden" button, i.e. it detects the ad blocker and asks to disable it for the site. wiwo.de is a German site (html lang="de", German-language WirtschaftsWoche article), so the German-wall clause applies rather than the general anti-adblock clause. Run instruction:⁠ "The agent never closes an issue. 'Recommend closing' below means the report says no rule is needed; a maintainer checks it and decides." — this outcome recommends closing; the decision stays with a maintainer.

## Artifacts

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"efa39c6e40f29e6d70199ae1261c40b2445428dadc22c18e326f93b8b589c8dd"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — www⁠.freetv.com serves a fixed bottom "Install the FreeTV app" banner (app icon, Google Play badge, X close) that overlays the mobile page, and nothing in the repository covers the site; the candidate freetv.com#⁠#⁠.install-android hid it in the apply_rule probe (visible in B, hidden in C, no damage, no remaining instances) but the bound vision review stayed inconclusive because the site's own cookie-consent notice occupies the same bottom strip. It is carried for human review for the AdGuard Mobile App Banners filter.

## Candidate for review

`freetv.com##.install-android`

AnnoyancesFilter/MobileApp/sections/mobile-app_specific.txt

Not verified: Two apply_rule runs of the same candidate both returned environmentExperiment "inconclusive" with no failedCandidateChecks:⁠ the bound vision review could not confirm the removal because the site's own cookie-consent notice occupies the same fixed bottom strip (y\~620-812) in the before and after states, and the 375x6827 px full-page overview was only inspectable for y=0..2116. The experiment's own probe reported .install-android "visible" in phase B and "hidden" in phase C, remainingInstances empty and observedDamage empty; an independent vision read of the after viewport artifact 6df50d95 shows no app-install banner and an intact page, and body/html computed padding-bottom is 0px, so the rule leaves no layout gap. Nothing rejected the candidate; it could not be visually confirmed against the consent overlay.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40827378888

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported URL is the Google Play listing for the Android app ru.lewis.dbo ("МТС Деньги"), and the reporter's screenshot is a loan-offer banner creative rendered inside the app itself. The listing page loaded successfully through the AdGuard CLI proxy with the reporter's official filter baseline and contains no such banner, no ad container and no ad-network request, so there is nothing on this URL for a filter rule to fix.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy lists no rule that blocks this report (it is not first-party site advertising, not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not a missing-detector anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing page), so per the repository policy section every report stays open to rule generation. No rule is proposed because live evidence shows the reporter-defined defect is absent from the successfully loaded reported page, not because a policy rule forbids one.

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — On the reachable reported page the embedded Snack example renders and works, and no rule in this repository (or in the applied-rule log) blocks anything belonging to it; the reporter's "Switching device..." emulator state only appears after clicking a tab inside a cross-origin snack.expo.dev iframe, which the browser tools refuse to click, so the breakage could not be reproduced and no rule change is proposed.

## Missing information

- No tool can rehearse a control inside a cross-origin iframe: The reported flow (reactnative.dev/docs/button#⁠example:⁠ select the Android/iOS tab under the embedded example, then launch the emulator) is driven entirely by controls inside the cross-origin iframe https:⁠//snack.expo.dev/embedded?...; no such control exists in the main document (checked light DOM and open shadow roots). interact_page refused the click with refusalReason "target_unavailable", and open_page refuses off-origin navigation to the snack embed URL ("URL must remain on configured issue origin"), so the device-mode state in which the reporter sees "Switching device..." can be neither rehearsed nor captured in phase B of apply_rule. Guidance on how to reach symptoms that live behind a cross-origin iframe is missing.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40852857194

It embeds a chat assistant > ("AI-assistent" button) that must ask for consent before it can store a session. > Consent is handled by Cookiebot, loaded by the assistant with data-blockingmode="none". > > With the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter on, https://consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js is blocked by > `||cookiebot.com^$3p`. The assistant cannot read the consent state, shows an error > ("We kunnen je cookie-voorkeuren niet opslaan") and cannot be used at all. > No banner is hidden; the whole feature is unusable. Pausing AdGuard on the site fixes it. > > Suggested fix, like other sites in the filter: > `@@||consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js$domain=thuisarts.nl` > > Same request at EasyList: https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/26146 > I work for the team that builds the assistant for Thuisarts.nl. ``` Username: @dptty ``` ### Screenshots

Despite multiple troubleshooting steps and clean reinstalls, the app window never appears on the screen. > > Here is the full background and a detailed list of everything that has been done so far: > > ### Hardware Context & Trigger: > 1. The issue started right after I performed major hardware changes: I replaced my GeForce GTX 970 with an RTX 4090 and reset my BIOS. > 2. Due to separate system/memory issues with the new card, I physically removed the RTX 4090 and reinstalled my original GTX 970. > 3. Since reverting back to the GTX 970, the AdGuard UI has completely disappeared and fails to load. > > ### Troubleshooting Steps Already Taken: > * Service Verification: I checked Windows Services (services.msc). The AdGuard Service is registered, status is Running, and it is set to Automatic. The background filtering engine seems to be working, but the GUI doesn't trigger. > * Direct Execution Commands: I attempted to force-launch the interface via the Windows Run dialog using "C:\Program Files\AdGuard\AdGuard.exe" /show as well as /show /reset. The command executes without any Windows error popup, but absolutely nothing happens on screen. > * Compatibility & Admin Mode: I applied "Run as Administrator" and tested running the executable in Windows 8 Compatibility Mode, with no success. > * Official Cleanup & Reinstallation: I downloaded and used the official AdGuard Uninstall Utility to perform a Standard Uninstall without deleting my user settings. After restarting the PC, I downloaded the latest installer from the official website and reinstalled it. The installer finished successfully, but the UI still won't open. > * GPU Hardware Acceleration Test: Suspecting a display conflict, I tried executing the command with the GPU bypass flag: "C:\Program Files\AdGuard\AdGuard.exe" /disable-gpu, but the interface still failed to render. > * Graphics Drivers Cleanup: I performed a completely clean installation of the official NVIDIA graphics drivers for the GTX 970 using the "Perform a clean installation" option to wipe any leftover registry paths or driver traces from the RTX 4090. The drivers were successfully updated, yet the issue persists. > * Antivirus Exclusion: I temporarily disabled my Avast Antivirus shields to ensure it wasn't silently blocking the UI thread from launching, which made no difference. > > ### Current State: > Fortunately, I have a safe manual backup of my %ProgramData%\Adguard folder (including the Backups directory with my .zip configuration files) saved on my desktop, so my data is secured. > > However, since the WPF/XAML graphical interface entirely fails to load, I cannot access my settings, check my license, or interact with the app. > > Given that the background service is running but the GUI is completely unresponsive (likely due to a deep rendering hook conflict caused by the GPU swapping/BIOS reset), could you please advise on how to force the UI to initialize or debug this specific crash? > > Thank you in advance for your assistance! ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# Creating the pull request

> Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed\
> If the related issue does not exist in our repository, please create it before making pull request\
> It is highly recommended to use our [Web Reporting Tool](https://kb.adguard.com/technical-support/reporting-tool) instead of creating an issue on GitHub directly\
> Please note, that we verify every pull request manually, so it may take time to apply it

## Prerequisites

### To avoid invalid pull requests, please check and confirm following terms

- [x] This is not an ad/bug report;
- [x] My code follows the [guidelines](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [syntax](https://kb.adguard.com/general/how-to-create-your-own-ad-filters) of this project;
- [x] I have performed a self-review of my own changes;
- [x] My changes do not break web sites, apps and files structure.

## What problem does the pull request fix?

### If the problem does not fall under any category that is listed here, please write a comment below in corresponding section

- [x] Missed ads or ad leftovers;
- [ ] Website or app doesn't work properly;
- [ ] AdGuard gets detected on a website;
- [ ] Missed analytics or tracker;
- [ ] Social media buttons — share, like, tweet, etc;
- [ ] Annoyances — pop-ups, cookie warnings, etc;
- [x] Filters maintenance.

## What issue is being fixed?

### Enter the issue address

Fix #245499
Fix #245528
Fix #245624

Updated the regex patterns to match new AS URL's and added `index.hr`, `euronews.com` & `base64decode.org` to the rules.

Here are some example AS URL's
```
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/commons/0_qnj.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/ui2kit/xzCF_UOD4t.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/polyfills/RUTe-7.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/lib.core/OZv_Vmt.js
https://coil.ruleacidly.com/vendor2/1DF_pzwE.js
https://fun.whollyeven.com/pkg64/3k-7c.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/main9a/F2MB-I.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/assets/t-LiwNBOD.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/chunks/s-PV5i.js
https://coil.injectoften.com/main.v2/WJ_GVse.js
https://disk.robinorchid.com/rt_main/5ir-jU.js
```

Sites using these:
``
https://www.mavericktruckclub.com/
https://spanjevandaag.com/
https://www.index.hr/
https://windsorstar.com/
https://www.euronews.com/
https://deadline.com/
``

Note: EasyList has been doing a good job of blocking the domains, but unfortunately, the delay before the rules are added to AdGuard means they often aren’t blocked in time, since AS frequently changes domains.

### Terms

- [x] By submitting this issue, I agree that pull request does not contain private info and all conditions are met

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://thuisarts.nl/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthuisarts.nl%2F) ### Comment > thuisarts.nl is a non-commercial Dutch public health site. It embeds a chat assistant > ("AI-assistent" button) that must ask for consent before it can store a session. > Consent is handled by Cookiebot, loaded by the assistant with data-blockingmode="none". > > With the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter on, https://consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js is blocked by > `||cookiebot.com^$3p`. The assistant cannot read the consent state, shows an error > ("We kunnen je cookie-voorkeuren niet opslaan") and cannot be used at all. > No banner is hidden; the whole feature is unusable. Pausing AdGuard on the site fixes it. > > Suggested fix, like other sites in the filter: > `@@||consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js$domain=thuisarts.nl` > > Same request at EasyList: https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/26146 > I work for the team that builds the assistant for Thuisarts.nl. ``` Username: @dptty ``` ### Screenshots

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://thuisarts.nl/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthuisarts.nl%2F) ### Comment > thuisarts.nl is a non-commercial Dutch public health site. It embeds a chat assistant > ("AI-assistent" button) that must ask for consent before it can store a session. > Consent is handled by Cookiebot, loaded by the assistant with data-blockingmode="none". > > With the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter on, https://consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js is blocked by > `||cookiebot.com^$3p`. The assistant cannot read the consent state, shows an error > ("We kunnen je cookie-voorkeuren niet opslaan") and cannot be used at all. > No banner is hidden; the whole feature is unusable. Pausing AdGuard on the site fixes it. > > Suggested fix, like other sites in the filter: > `@@||consent.cookiebot.com/uc.js$domain=thuisarts.nl` > > Same request at EasyList: https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/26146 > I work for the team that builds the assistant for Thuisarts.nl. ``` Username: @dptty ``` ### Screenshots

The optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue. > > - **Full:** https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt > - **Optimized:** https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt > > ### Reproduction Results > > | Filters enabled | Result | > | --- | --- | > | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) | > | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) | > | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock IS shown (NG) | > | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) | > | Base only | Normal (OK) | > > ### Note on the optimized filter as a workaround > > Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed. > > ### Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue) > > - Updated the filter rules to the latest version > - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version > - Restarted the device > - Cleared Safari's cache > - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again > - Restarted Safari > - Restarted AdGuard > - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 2 min) > > ### Additional Information > > - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out. > - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between. > ### Screenshots

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reported annoyance on www⁠.minhaoperadora.com.br is a fixed bottom WhatsApp-channel subscription bar (#⁠mo-floating-banner). A domain-scoped element-hiding rule verified in the reporter's settings profile:⁠ the bar is gone, layout intact and no residue. ## Rule `minhaoperadora.com.br###mo-floating-banner` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No closing rule in the run instruction applies:⁠ the target is not a first-party ad slot, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall (no detector script was captured and the page shows no ad-blocker message). The reported element is a subscription prompt for the site's own WhatsApp channel — the kind of in-page subscription annoyance the Annoyances filters cover, and the same file already holds a subscription-widget rule for this very domain. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c7a552d5f7f6db9e14beaed555f26162890badb1/AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40867986462 Automated analysis against filters at `c7a552d`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://mpuls.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmpuls.ru%2F)

### Comment
> False positive: mpuls.ru is currently the MPuls marketplace product card generator, not a third-party advertising network. Please review and remove the domain-wide block and the source rule from which it is derived.
> 
> Confirmed on 29 October 2026:
> 
> 1. AdGuard DNS filter contains `||mpuls.ru^`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
> 2. The Cyrillic filter source contains `||mpuls.ru^$third-party`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdguardFilters/CyrillicFilters/common-sections/adservers.txt
> 3. `dig @94.140.14.14 mpuls.ru A` returns `0.0.0.0` with `EDE: 17 (Filtered)`.
> 4. Google 8.8.8.8, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9 9.9.9.9 and Yandex resolvers return the correct address, `194.38.11.116`.
> 5. With the correct DNS answer, https://mpuls.ru/api/health returns HTTP 200 and `{"ready":true}` with a valid TLS certificate. External probes from multiple Russian cities also succeed. One Novosibirsk probe using a filtering resolver failed; the same probe succeeded when querying 1.1.1.1. This does not imply ISP-wide blocking.
> 
> Reproduction: query the public default AdGuard DNS resolver directly as above and compare with 1.1.1.1. This is browser-independent. Visitors report endless loading or a blank page when the domain is blocked.
> 
> Attachment clarification: the first image formats actual recorded DNS diagnostic output and is explicitly labelled as such; it is not a visitor browser screenshot. The second image is the actual live homepage rendered through a working DNS connection. No AdGuard extension settings were changed for these tests.
> 
> Please remove the incorrect classification in the source filter and update the derived DNS filter. We can provide domain-control verification if needed.
> 
> Public service contact: `support@mpuls.ru.` No credentials or private user data are included.



### Screenshots

  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/qmoqi19bx8g0ko8wskg80sw4s4o4gs4iq1utynxhk0.png?nc=1)

### Comment
> False positive: mpuls.ru is currently the MPuls marketplace product card generator, not a third-party advertising network. Please review and remove the domain-wide block and the source rule from which it is derived.
> 
> Confirmed on 29 October 2026:
> 
> 1. AdGuard DNS filter contains `||mpuls.ru^`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
> 2. The Cyrillic filter source contains `||mpuls.ru^$third-party`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdguardFilters/CyrillicFilters/common-sections/adservers.txt
> 3. `dig @94.140.14.14 mpuls.ru A` returns `0.0.0.0` with `EDE: 17 (Filtered)`.

> 5. With the correct DNS answer, https://mpuls.ru/api/health returns HTTP 200 and `{"ready":true}` with a valid TLS certificate. External probes from multiple Russian cities also succeed. The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — With the full AdGuard baseline (a superset of the reporter's Base + Japanese full) h178.com/schedule loads normally, the calendar renders, and the site's own anti-adblock notice (#⁠ab-warning) stays hidden because the content wrapper it watches (.file-display-area) is never hidden — no rule in the repository hides it and no request is blocked. Structured full-page vision confirms the reported symptom is absent (desktop and mobile viewport), so no rule is needed; the iOS/Safari execution model could not be exercised here.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction states no rule that closes this report. Its German anti-adblock clause does not apply (the site is Japanese, and the reporter's 'anti-adblock' framing is not evidence of the wall that clause covers), and the incorrect-blocking route explicitly allows a narrowly scoped exception when filtering breaks page function. The anti-adblock clause that requires a captured detector-script request only gates writing an anti-adblock rule; no rule is generated here because the reported breakage was not observed in the filtered browser, so that gate is not what stops this run. No paywall, first-party-ad or out-of-scope (scam/phishing/malware) condition applies to this report.

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://mpuls.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmpuls.ru%2F)

### Comment
> False positive: mpuls.ru is currently the MPuls marketplace product card generator, not a third-party advertising network. Please review and remove the domain-wide block and the source rule from which it is derived.
> 
> Confirmed on 29 October 2026:
> 
> 1. AdGuard DNS filter contains `||mpuls.ru^`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
> 2. The Cyrillic filter source contains `||mpuls.ru^$third-party`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdguardFilters/CyrillicFilters/common-sections/adservers.txt
> 3. `dig @94.140.14.14 mpuls.ru A` returns `0.0.0.0` with `EDE: 17 (Filtered)`.
> 4. Google 8.8.8.8, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9 9.9.9.9 and Yandex resolvers return the correct address, `194.38.11.116`.
> 5. With the correct DNS answer, https://mpuls.ru/api/health returns HTTP 200 and `{"ready":true}` with a valid TLS certificate. External probes from multiple Russian cities also succeed. One Novosibirsk probe using a filtering resolver failed; the same probe succeeded when querying 1.1.1.1. This does not imply ISP-wide blocking.
> 
> Reproduction: query the public default AdGuard DNS resolver directly as above and compare with 1.1.1.1. This is browser-independent. Visitors report endless loading or a blank page when the domain is blocked.
> 
> Attachment clarification: the first image formats actual recorded DNS diagnostic output and is explicitly labelled as such; it is not a visitor browser screenshot. The second image is the actual live homepage rendered through a working DNS connection. No AdGuard extension settings were changed for these tests.
> 
> Please remove the incorrect classification in the source filter and update the derived DNS filter. We can provide domain-control verification if needed.
> 
> Public service contact: `support@mpuls.ru.` No credentials or private user data are included.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"d478e7d36da2ae0bee863f9bbbe198c6b47ce759d6e732c361b8c5ef17d3b782"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Not reproduced — With the reporter's own filter selection loaded from their settings import, the dzen.ru article renders no ad card at all:⁠ Yandex/MyTarget ad requests (ad.mail.ru, yandex.ru/ads) are blocked by the published Base and Russian rules, every ad slot stays empty, and full-page vision of the prepared session found the reported ad absent. An unfiltered control on the same page does show "Реклама" ad cards, so the reported ads could not be reproduced and no new rule is needed; recommend closing after a maintainer check, since egress was not from Russia and creatives rotate.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Policy rationale

No run-instruction policy rule blocks a rule here:⁠ the reported ad is third-party Yandex/MyTarget inventory (ad.mail.ru, yandex.ru/ads), not the site's own advertising, so the 'first-party ads:⁠ no rule' rule does not apply. The report is not an anti-adblock wall, not a paywall and not a scam/phishing page, so none of the instruction's close or hand-off rules applies. Closing is recommended on evidence rather than policy:⁠ with the reporter's own filter selection the reported ad card does not render, so there is no symptom for a new rule to fix.

## Artifacts

The optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue. > > - **Full:** https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt > - **Optimized:** https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt > > ### Reproduction Results > > | Filters enabled | Result | > | --- | --- | > | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) | > | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) | > | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock IS shown (NG) | > | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) | > | Base only | Normal (OK) | > > ### Note on the optimized filter as a workaround > > Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed. > > ### Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue) > > - Updated the filter rules to the latest version > - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version > - Restarted the device > - Cleared Safari's cache > - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again > - Restarted Safari > - Restarted AdGuard > - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 2 min) > > ### Additional Information > > - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out. > - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between. > ### Screenshots

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Reported symptom (issue #⁠245710, Annoyance, AdGuard for Windows v7.22.7):⁠ a centered cookie-consent dialog "Käytämme evästeitä" ("Mukauta" / "Hyväksy kaikki") covers the hero banner and the top of the "Suosituimmat" product grid on https:⁠//www⁠.multitronic.fi/fi/. The reporter drew no annotation; the dialog is the only overlay in the screenshot and it was confirmed present on the live page. Evidence:⁠ the modal is first-party markup `#cookiesConsent` ⁠> `#consentMainSection`, inserted by the first-party asset `/js/consent.js?21072026` (HAR artifact:⁠har:⁠5502ddde-b7bf-4733-9733-89f73d7f4143), which XHRs `/fi/ajax/getConsentForm/` and then sets body class `disableScroll` with `overflow: hidden` (scroll lock). Reading the served consent.js source in the browser shows the current code writes its decision to cookie `consentCookieV2` (setCookie('consentCookieV2', JSON.stringify(...), 180)) with the deny object `{consentAnalytics:false, consentAds:false, functionality_storage:true, security_storage:true, personalization_storage:true, ad_storage:false, ad_user_data:false, ad_personalization:false, analytics_storage:false}`. The repository's existing site rule in AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt sets the obsolete `consentCookie` with a two-key object; get_applied_rules confirmed the CLI applies that rule to the page and the dialog still appears, so the rule is stale rather than missing. Environment:⁠ the report comes from AdGuard for Windows, which filters at network level, so the adguard_cli route was locked. (shortened; the full text is in the run artifacts)

issue.title: speedof.me: AdGuard Base rules hide mobile START TEST and results

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://mpuls.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmpuls.ru%2F)

### Comment
> False positive: mpuls.ru is currently the MPuls marketplace product card generator, not a third-party advertising network. Please review and remove the domain-wide block and the source rule from which it is derived.
> 
> Confirmed on 29 October 2026:
> 
> 1. AdGuard DNS filter contains `||mpuls.ru^`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
> 2. The Cyrillic filter source contains `||mpuls.ru^$third-party`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdguardFilters/CyrillicFilters/common-sections/adservers.txt
> 3. `dig @94.140.14.14 mpuls.ru A` returns `0.0.0.0` with `EDE: 17 (Filtered)`.
> 4. Google 8.8.8.8, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9 9.9.9.9 and Yandex resolvers return the correct address, `194.38.11.116`.
> 5. With the correct DNS answer, https://mpuls.ru/api/health returns HTTP 200 and `{"ready":true}` with a valid TLS certificate. External probes from multiple Russian cities also succeed. One Novosibirsk probe using a filtering resolver failed; the same probe succeeded when querying 1.1.1.1. This does not imply ISP-wide blocking.
> 
> Reproduction: query the public default AdGuard DNS resolver directly as above and compare with 1.1.1.1. This is browser-independent. Visitors report endless loading or a blank page when the domain is blocked.
> 
> Attachment clarification: the first image formats actual recorded DNS diagnostic output and is explicitly labelled as such; it is not a visitor browser screenshot. The second image is the actual live homepage rendered through a working DNS connection. No AdGuard extension settings were changed for these tests.
> 
> Please remove the incorrect classification in the source filter and update the derived DNS filter. We can provide domain-control verification if needed.
> 
> Public service contact: `support@mpuls.ru.` No credentials or private user data are included.



### Screenshots

  ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/qmoqi19bx8g0ko8wskg80sw4s4o4gs4iq1utynxhk0.png?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/quh1zmezn1ck4k4w88w0ks8ssw084ss4gwth68266m.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

DNS server: | AdGuard DNS Default server

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://mpuls.ru/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmpuls.ru%2F)

### Comment
> False positive: mpuls.ru is currently the MPuls marketplace product card generator, not a third-party advertising network. Please review and remove the domain-wide block and the source rule from which it is derived.
> 
> Confirmed on 29 October 2026:
> 
> 1. AdGuard DNS filter contains `||mpuls.ru^`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdGuardSDNSFilter/Filters/filter.txt
> 2. The Cyrillic filter source contains `||mpuls.ru^$third-party`:
> https://adguardteam.github.io/AdguardFilters/CyrillicFilters/common-sections/adservers.txt
> 3. `dig @94.140.14.14 mpuls.ru A` returns `0.0.0.0` with `EDE: 17 (Filtered)`.
> 4. Google 8.8.8.8, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Quad9 9.9.9.9 and Yandex resolvers return the correct address, `194.38.11.116`.
> 5. With the correct DNS answer, https://mpuls.ru/api/health returns HTTP 200 and `{"ready":true}` with a valid TLS certificate. External probes from multiple Russian cities also succeed. One Novosibirsk probe using a filtering resolver failed; the same probe succeeded when querying 1.1.1.1. This does not imply ISP-wide blocking.
> 
> Reproduction: query the public default AdGuard DNS resolver directly as above and compare with 1.1.1.1. This is browser-independent. Visitors report endless loading or a blank page when the domain is blocked.
> 
> Attachment clarification: the first image formats actual recorded DNS diagnostic output and is explicitly labelled as such; it is not a visitor browser screenshot. The second image is the actual live homepage rendered through a working DNS connection. No AdGuard extension settings were changed for these tests.
> 
> Please remove the incorrect classification in the source filter and update the derived DNS filter. We can provide domain-control verification if needed.
> 
> Public service contact: `support@mpuls.ru.` No credentials or private user data are included.



### Screenshots
<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/qmoqi19bx8g0ko8wskg80sw4s4o4gs4iq1utynxhk0.png?nc=1)
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Screenshot 1 with AdGuard disabled</summary>

  ![Screenshot 1](https://reports.adguard.info/stcdn/sitereports/quh1zmezn1ck4k4w88w0ks8ssw084ss4gwth68266m.jpg?nc=1)
</details>

### System configuration

| Information | Value |
|-------------|-------|
AdGuard product: | AdGuard DNS
DNS setup: | Direct DNS query using dig @94.140.14.14
DNS server: | AdGuard DNS Default server
System version: | `Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; reported by visitors on different devices`
Browser: | Browser-independent DNS failure, reproduced with dig and external HTTPS probes

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"dcf69ffc81801fb3def240970845ceb18b8586fed70e57fd4ae19a2f307b4f3b"} -->
The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — m.ekn.kr loads cleanly and full-page vision finds the reporter's annotated defect absent, with no third-party ad content rendering on the page — the Ad Manager slots never render and the Taboola loader produces no feed there, and the only ad-like blocks are the site's own NCTimes partner banner and news card. Recommend closing as not reproduced; the issue's screenshot shows an unrelated Naver gallery page and the reporter's text is an Android app HTTPS-filtering complaint.

## Policy rationale

No policy rule in the run instruction closes this report on its face:⁠ it is not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall, not a scam/phishing page, and it is not an anti-adblock report at all, so rule generation was allowed and the report was investigated on live evidence. The close reason is reproduction, not policy:⁠ structured full-page vision of the loaded reported page returns reporterSymptomPresence=absent and instanceCount=0, and the network and DOM inventory show no third-party ad content. Supporting note (not the decision):⁠ the only ad-like blocks present are the site's own / partner promotion served first-party (m.ekn.kr/images/banner/… and nctimes.co.kr/boxFrame.html?b=33), which the repository policy does not target — "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing".

## Artifacts

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

Fallback — The page refused to load in the run browser:⁠ main document returned HTTP 403

Indeterminate — The report targets a self-hosted OpenPanel analytics endpoint (op.fintables.com/api/track) that the reporter's Tracking Protection filter does not cover; the fix is a network rule for that host in the first-party tracking-server section. The site returned HTTP 403 ("Just a moment...") on every navigation profile, so the request could not be re-observed and the candidate stayed unverified.

## Candidate for review

`||op.fintables.com^`

SpywareFilter/sections/tracking_servers_firstparty.txt

Whether blocking the whole op.fintables.com host disrupts site functionality (the policy's exception for tracking protection) therefore also remains unchecked.

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body:

Also, if you use a workaround to bypass an ad blocker, this won't be the first time something goes wrong.

This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 3 days with no activity.
Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.
Please note, that AdGuard Filters is an open-source project that is used by different content blockers and we welcome contributions. If you have some technical knowledge about how websites work, you are welcome to create a pull request following [these instructions](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"4cb6ca78fc08fcf74b4ceca489e2724bae044359d6dd1feb564f617e324c975f"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

www⁠.ligainsider.de serves a German adblock-detection wall ("Adblocker erkannt", "Schalte deinen Adblocker für ligainsider.de aus…") through its Sourcepoint CMP message, with a paid subscription as the alternative; the run instruction's policy gives German anti-adblock walls no rule, so a maintainer should close the report.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, filter policy:⁠ "German anti-adblock walls:⁠ no rule; recommend closing. This covers only a German site's wall or popup that detects the ad blocker and asks to disable it or to allowlist the site." The page itself (reporter screenshot, German site ligainsider.de) states "Adblocker erkannt" and "Schalte deinen Adblocker für ligainsider.de aus und lies wie gewohnt kostenlos weiter", so the report is exactly this excluded class. Run instruction, filter policy:⁠ "Paywalls:⁠ no rule; recommend closing" - the wall's alternative path is a paid subscription ("LigaInsider ohne Werbung lesen", 3,99 EUR/Monat). Run instruction:⁠ "The agent never closes an issue. 'Recommend closing' below means the report says no rule is needed; a maintainer checks it and decides." - so this outcome is a close recommendation for a maintainer, not a closure. Filter policy (AdguardTeam/KnowledgeBase docs/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy.md, Limitations and exceptions) does not block ad-blocker detection messages that offer an alternative to disabling the blocker or let the user proceed to the content, which matches this German wall. No rule was generated, so no lint or apply_rule validation applies to this outcome.

## Artifacts

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On upfilesgo.com the filtered page swaps the server-rendered "Free Download" button for an inline anti-adblock notice ("Please disable your ad blocker to continue."), and a domain-scoped trusted scriptlet that drops that notice markup from innerHTML assignments restores the download button. The candidate was verified by the A/B/C experiment:⁠ symptom resolved, page integrity intact, no remaining instances. ## Rule `upfilesgo.com#%#//scriptlet('trusted-create-element', 'head', 'script', '', '(()=>{const d=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(Element.prototype,"innerHTML"),s=d.set,g=d.get;Object.defineProperty(Element.prototype,"innerHTML",{configurable:true,get(){return g.call(this)},set(v){if(typeof v==="string"&&v.includes("disable your ad blocker"))return;s.call(this,v)}})})();')` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The page shows a real anti-adblock wall:⁠ the free download is withheld and replaced by 'Please disable your ad blocker to continue.', which effectively prevents using the site's main function, so it is not one of the detection messages the policy leaves alone. The policy requires the captured requests to show the detector script before a rule is written:⁠ the captured HAR contains the page's first-party gate/detector assets https:⁠//upfilesgo.com/build/assets/file-gate-ptAERgKB.js and https:⁠//upfilesgo.com/_v/s.js, and the page exposes the detector API window.vhit.detectAdblock with an integrity/attestation module. The site is not German, is not a paywall, and its own advertising is not the target — the target is the ad-blocker detection notice. The repository already fixes this same site family's detector in BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt (chp_ads_blocker), so the fix fits established practice. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/74d3190084c3dbdaaafa40c43516dbcd19fe5dc5/BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 7004](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/74d3190084c3dbdaaafa40c43516dbcd19fe5dc5/BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt#L7004). ## Screenshots

The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

On the reported dnepr.info article the filtered baseline shows no advertising at all — no ad-network request, no ad slot, no empty ad container — and the two elements the reporter marked are the site's own native share control and a "Підпишіться на наш Facebook або Telegram" panel linking only to the site's own social pages. The filter policy excludes exactly these (site's own promotion; widgets that are part of the site's functionality; links to the website's social media pages), so no rule should be written and the issue is recommended for closing on policy grounds.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction, Filter policy:⁠ 'The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing.' Both reporter-marked targets are the site's own first-party UI on dnepr.info's own article page:⁠ a native share control (button.share-trigger) and a 'Підпишіться на наш Facebook або Telegram' panel built from the site's own sprite icons and links to its own accounts (facebook.com/novosti.dnepr.info, t.me/Dnepr_Info_New). Filter policy document linked by the run instruction, Social media filters / Limitations and exceptions:⁠ 'Widgets that are part of the website's functionality or content ... are not blocked' and 'Links to the website's social media pages are also not blocked.' The marked share control is the site's own share functionality and the marked panel contains nothing but links to the website's own social media pages, so both are excluded from Social filter rules. Filter policy, Ad blocking filters:⁠ 'The site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked.' A self-promotion panel of the site's own channels is exactly that kind of first-party promotion, not third-party advertising. No advertising defect exists to fix on the reported page:⁠ the filtered baseline loaded the article with 34 requests and no ad-network host (only googletagmanager.com/gtm.js, already blocked by the shared Tracking Protection rule), inspect_ad_slots found 0 ad-slot candidates, and the only iframe is the site's Telegram embedded post (artifact:⁠har:⁠8a510db5-6a59-40c8-a4fd-9f9d999f7a0a).

## Missing information

- Run instruction policy list has no entry for reports that mark first-party social/share widgets: The run instruction's Filter policy lists only first-party ads, paywalls, German anti-adblock walls, other anti-adblock walls and scam/malware pages. Issue #⁠245726 marks a native share control (button.share-trigger) and a first-party "Підпишіться на наш Facebook або Telegram" panel whose only links are the site's own social pages, with no advertising anywhere on the page. Nothing in the run instruction states whether such first-party social/promotional UI is fixable, so the decision had to be derived from the linked filter-policy document (Social media filters:⁠ "Links to the website's social media pages are also not blocked", "Widgets that are part of the website's functionality or content ... are not blocked").
- No session could take the reporter settings import:⁠ extension "none" refuses settings and the prepared session reports settingsVerified:⁠false: The run instruction says to launch every evidence session with extension:⁠"none" for the adguard_cli route, while also requiring the reporter profile reported_on_current from the issue's reports.adguard.com import URL. launch_browser refuses `settings` with extension:⁠"none" ("A control session runs no blocker and takes no settings"), and the extension:⁠"prepared" launch with settings {kind:⁠"reported_on_current", importUrl:⁠...} answered settingsVerified:⁠false with settingsEvidence:⁠null, so no session could be established as the reporter profile and apply_rule could only run against an issue-derived baseline.

issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? AdGuard Browser Extension ### AdGuard version 5.5.3.3 (MV3 browser extension) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Chrome ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://speedof.me/m/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy _No response_ ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances AdGuard Cookie Notices filter, AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter ### Security _No response_ ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots Hi, the recent filter changes associated with #245320 break the mobile speed test on SpeedOf.Me: https://speedof.me/m/ (build 3.205.2509). The START TEST control disappears, so visitors cannot start a speed test. With AdGuard disabled, the control is visible again. ### Rules responsible This rule hides the mobile START TEST control and the introductory text: ```text speedof.me###intro_container > div:not(.intro-group-container, .intro-dots) ``` This rule also matches the entire mobile results panel because `#result_container` is missing from its exceptions: ```text speedof.me##.middle-container > div:not(#progress_container, #share_container, #history_container, #intro_container) ``` ### Reproduction 1. Open https://speedof.me/m/ at a mobile viewport (390 × 844 in this reproduction). 2. Enable AdGuard with the filters listed above and the current published speedof.me rules. 3. Reload: the START TEST control and introductory text are missing. 4. Disable AdGuard and reload: START TEST and the introductory text return. Captured on October 28, 2026 using Chromium 143.0.7499.169 with AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 v5.5.3.3 at a mobile viewport. These are desktop Chrome captures of the mobile site, not captures from an Android or iOS device. Enabled filters: AdGuard Base 2.4.93.84, Cookie Notices 2.0.95.55, Popups 2.0.84.8, and Other Annoyances 2.0.48.76. The current published speedof.me rules from AdguardFilters revision `5a6d91f` were also loaded as user rules because bundled lists can lag the repository. No additional experimental blocking rules were used. Also reproduced with Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.73 on macOS ARM64 at 390 × 844 using the same published rules. With only the intro-container rule exempted, START TEST returned and a real test completed, but the results panel and Repeat control remained hidden. Please revise the rules to preserve the START TEST control and mobile results panel. ### House promotions Separately, some placements promote SpeedOf.Me's own API, MCP integration, and connection certificate. These are promotions for the site's own services without third-party compensation. Could you review their treatment under the Base-filter policy concerning a site's own advertising? https://adguard.com/kb/general/ad-filtering/filter-policy/#limitations-and-exceptions Compensated affiliate offers have a different classification. ### Screenshots AdGuard enabled: START TEST and the introductory content are missing. AdGuard disabled: START TEST and the introductory content are visible. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition

comment.body:
Thanks for the START TEST fix. Please remove two of the new rules; both block our own first-party content.

`speedof.me##.home-promos` links only to our own services, and no third party pays for them. Your policy says a site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked.

`||speedof.me/api/uc.php` blocks a first-party endpoint our site relies on. It serves no ads.
